pages.text: $(l)Mounting:$() Right-click a machine to mount it.$(br2)$(l)Movement:$() Use WASD to move and aim the machine.$(br2)$(l)Fire:$() Press F to fire!$(br2)$(l)Inventory:$() Press I to open inventory.

pages.title: More Controls
pages.text: $(l)Dismount:$() Press Shift to dismount.$(br2)$(l)Siege Ladder:$() Press Space to transfer to climbing position, then W/S to climb up/down.$(br2)$(br)Remember to load ammunition before firing!
